notes: Replace the removed Polynomial.coeff name in goal1 with AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff, with universe arguments inferred. Original Polynomial.coeff extracts the coefficient of its underlying AddMonoidAlgebra; on the target Polynomial is an abbreviation for AddMonoidAlgebra R ℕ. The theorem proposition is equivalent under this representation change; its proof is unchanged.
